snapshotId.description: recover: exact pending snapshot id from inspect.

expectedCurrentHash.description: recover: SHA256 from fresh inspect, mutually exclusive with expectedMissing:true.

expectedMissing.description: recover: explicit confirmation target is absent; mutually exclusive with hash.

snapshotIds.description: prune: exact eligible completed ids. Never pending/resolved/newest8.

confirm.description: prune writes only with true plus nonempty snapshotIds; otherwise preview.

transactionId.description: Required for explicit revert apply/cancel/recover; use ID and fresh currentDigest from inspect scope=revert. Normal revert needs ref+author.

scope.description: Required explicit scope: revert only readonly inspect; index/map inspect/recover/prune. map needs no dir; other scopes need existing mapping.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project (workdir) directory. Required for all commands except 'list' and inspect/recover/prune with scope map.

name.description: Repository name for gitdir (init), or branch name (branch).

filepath.description: File path relative to project dir, for add/status/checkout/diff/restore.

message.description: Commit message (commit), stash message (stash push), or tag message (tag create annotated).

depth.description: Max number of log entries (log), or clone depth (clone).

ref.description: Git ref (branch, commit, tag) for checkout/revert/push/pull/clone.

checkout.description: Whether to checkout after creating branch (default: true).

refIdx.description: Stash entry index for apply/drop/pop operations (default: 0).

url.description: Remote repository URL for remote add, clone, or push.

oid.description: Target commit OID for tag creation (default: HEAD).

lightweight.description: Create lightweight tag instead of annotated (default: false).

noCheckout.description: Skip working tree checkout during clone (default: false).

auth.description: Optional inline credentials for push/pull/clone. When provided, bypasses Keychain lookup and the auth prompt page. Useful for CI / automated scripts.

maxFiles.description: Add candidate-file budget or diff scan guard. Default 5000; 0 disables. Ref and working-tree diff both honor this guard.

maxEntries.description: Add scan/index entry budget; default 20000, 0 disables.

maxFileBytes.description: Add single-file byte budget; default 33554432, 0 disables.

maxTotalBytes.description: Add total candidate byte budget; default 268435456, 0 disables.

maxTransferBytes.description: Per HTTP body budget; default 67108864, 0 disables. Native responses are buffered before post-read validation when Content-Length is absent.

timeoutMs.description: Cooperative deadline in milliseconds; 0 disables. Not a hard interruption or transaction rollback.

dryRun.description: Add preflight without staging; revert readonly inverse planning only; normal apply requires explicit author and supported regular files.

summaryOnly.description: For diff, return status counts without the full change list.
